#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `limit` | `string` | **yes** | The spend limit's id (slim_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `spend_limit`. One of `spend_limit`. |
| `id` | `string` | slim_… |
| `customer` | `string` | cus_… |
| `scope` | `string` | The spend limit's scope. One of `customer`, `subscription`, `property`. |
| `subscription` | `string` | sub_…, for subscription scope. |
| `property_key` | `string` | The usage property, for property scope. |
| `property_value` | `string` | The property value. Null: each value gets the amount; a row with a value overrides it. |
| `meters` | `array of string` | Meter keys. Null: all meters. |
| `interval` | `string` | day, week (ISO, from Monday) and month are calendar intervals in the business's time zone. period is the term of the subscription that bills the usage. One of `day`, `week`, `month`, `period`. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | The limit, in minor units of `currency`. |
| `currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. |
| `mode` | `string` | The spend limit's mode. One of `hard`, `soft`. |
| `set_by` | `string` | The spend limit's set by. One of `operator`, `customer`. |
| `active` | `boolean` | True if the spend limit is active. |
| `effective_amount_minor` | `integer` | The amount that applies. A customer-scope hard limit you set is raised by a reached limit tier, unless you changed the limit after the tier was reached. Else amount_minor. |
| `spent_minor` | `integer` | Spend in the current interval. Null for a property limit with no property_value: each value has its own spend. |
| `reached` | `boolean` | spent_minor is at or above effective_amount_minor. |
| `resets_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. When the current interval ends. |
| `editable` | `boolean` | Portal only: the buyer set it, so the buyer can change it. |
| `created_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. |
| `updated_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The spend limit. |
| `404` | No such spend limit. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/spend_limits/slim_XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
